checks: With the signed row normalization of a19fb2ae234afb2a, d_1=0 makes the two excluded first margins equal. For P_1=(p,−r), P_2=(−x,b), P_3=(−x,−e), the numerator of d_2+d_3 is e−r+(p−r)−(b−x), giving exactly the stated constraint.

The strict signs give x>0, v=p−r>0, s=b−x>0 and positive excluded magnitudes e and r. Swapping labels 2 and 3 after (X,Y)↦(X,−X−Y) swaps the margins and sends (s,v,w) to (s+w,v+w,−w), where s+w=e>0 and v+w=r>0. Thus the representative may take w≥0, including w=0.

The signed vertex matrix has rows (p,−x,−x), (−v−w,b,−e), (−v,−s,c). Its column sums are zero and it has the required strict signs. The determinant of the two edges at P_1 is LB. The barycentric weights given in the proof sum to one and give zero, with last numerator bp−xr=xv+sp>0.

The area follows from the determinant. The positive-vertex clipping fractions are p/L on both incident cap-1 edges, b/H and b/B in cap 2, and c/H and c/B in cap 3. The corner altitude is its positive height divided by the normal norm, so coarea is twice corner area divided by the positive height. Independent exact symbolic checks reproduced the determinant, barycentric identities and cap areas.

The sum of cap area divided by coarea equals (p+b+c)/2=H. Consequently the displayed f-values and Φ_1=2 follow from L+B=2H. Source cfb017a0e12acfbf §1, (1)–(2) has the same full chart and unnormalized geometry.
